title: Reduce subtitle QA false blockers
summary: Reduces false blocked Subtitle QA labels by downgrading incomplete image-subtitle conversion metadata to review unless an explicit OCR/conversion failure is present, and keeps Completed table evidence focused on output, size, sidecar, consistency, and runtime blockers before advisory Subtitle QA review labels.
reason: Completed evidence boxes were showing repeated Subtitle QA blocked labels for rows that did not have explicit subtitle failures, obscuring the more relevant evidence such as size review.
behavior_before: Image-based subtitle decisions without a tool field were treated as blocked even when the row only lacked detailed conversion metadata. Completed table evidence displayed Subtitle QA before size/output/sidecar/runtime evidence.
behavior_after: Explicit OCR/conversion failures remain blocked. Missing image-subtitle conversion detail without failure evidence is review, and positive cue/output/status evidence prevents a false blocker. Completed table evidence shows output/size/sidecar/consistency/runtime issues before Subtitle QA advisory labels.
rollback_plan: Restore the prior image-subtitle missing-tool blocker logic, restore Completed table evidence precedence to show Subtitle QA first, and remove the added false-blocker tests.
notes: This fix does not hide actual subtitle failures. OCR/conversion failure text still produces blocked QA; missing metadata alone produces review.
